command_line:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("expected counts, layout, output")
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
out_path <- args[[3]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

if (grepl("\.csv$", counts_path, ignore.case=TRUE)) {
  counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
} else {
  counts <- read.delim(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

required <- c("SampleID", "Group")
if (!all(required %in% colnames(layout))) stop("sample layout lacks SampleID/Group")
layout$matrix_id <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
if (sum(keep) != 6) stop("expected exactly three DMSO and three CBD_IC50 samples")
if (!all(layout$matrix_id[keep] %in% colnames(counts))) stop("layout samples do not match count matrix columns")

meta <- layout[keep, c("SampleID", "Group", "matrix_id")]
meta$condition <- factor(ifelse(meta$Group == "DMSO", "DMSO", "CBD"), levels=c("DMSO", "CBD"))
counts <- counts[, meta$matrix_id, drop=FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(colnames(counts), meta$matrix_id), , drop=FALSE]
if (anyNA(meta$condition) || anyNA(colnames(counts))) stop("sample matching failed")
rownames(meta) <- meta$matrix_id

counts <- as.matrix(counts)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric")
if (anyNA(counts) || any(!is.finite(counts)) || any(counts < 0)) stop("counts must be finite nonnegative numbers")
if (any(abs(counts - round(counts)) > 0)) stop("counts must be integer-valued")
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=meta, design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD", "DMSO"), alpha=0.05)

out <- as.data.frame(res)
out$gene_id <- rownames(out)
out <- out[, c("gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
write.table(out, file=out_path, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="NA")
RSCRIPT
